intro: A recommended order to the platinum, built from the official trophy descriptions.

stages.title: First Steps — Prologue & Chapter 1
stages.summary: Drop into Leonida and finish the opening story beats. Everything here is story-gated and unmissable.

stages.title: Main Story — Chapters 2, 3 & 4
stages.summary: Advance the core storyline through the chapter missions. These unlock in order and cannot be missed.

stages.title: Final Story & Endgame Moments
stages.summary: The finale plus the special scripted moments: airport escape, partnership highlights, choices, retries, and the mystery chain.
missableWarnings: The 'second time's the charm' trophy wants you to fail once and succeed on the retry — it can be cleared any time.

stages.title: Strangers & Side Stories
stages.summary: Complete the stranger strands and side characters. Finishing a strand's final mission earns its trophy.
missableWarnings: The stranger finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) can be locked out if you finish the story before clearing them — do these strands before the finale.

stages.title: Activities & Events
stages.summary: Races, stunts, shooting range, fishing, arcade, meditation, robberies, and miscellaneous world events. Most overlap with normal play.
missableWarnings: Rob three shops back-to-back without dropping the wanted level — chain them on a single loop for an easy run.

stages.title: Completionist Cleanup
stages.summary: The long-tail grind: 100% completion, collectible sets, WAiNK locations, vehicles, exploration, garage properties, and the platinum.
